snippet.title: Exadimension Neptunia (FANGAME) - v1.11 / Chapter 6 Trailer
snippet.description:
Exadimension Neptunia is back in active development after a long hiatus!
The current version v1.11.0 goes up to Chapter 6 and provides roughly ~18 hours of playtime.

https://gamejolt.com/games/exadimension-neptunia/145529
